CustomField.description:
(Note: API name remains Dynamic_Pricing__c.) Updated Daily by Analytics Simple Loader based on Pro settings. SmartCampaigns is adjusting the cost of a lead based on a shopper's predicted intent to buy. SmartCampaigns was first introduced on 5/5/2026 as a Pilot only available to State Farm and Farmers agents in the States of MN or AZ. With intent to extend to all Agents in the future.
S3P-1282 - Created. 09/062026 - relabeled to SmartCampaigns (API name remains Dynamic_Pricing__c).
